import json, pathlib, subprocess, urllib.request
repo=pathlib.Path(r"E:\WebAIBridge")
def run(args):
    p=subprocess.run(args,cwd=str(repo),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=8)
    return p.stdout.decode(errors="replace").strip()
head=run(["git.exe","-C",str(repo),"rev-parse","HEAD"])
status=run(["git.exe","-C",str(repo),"status","--porcelain"]).splitlines()
cut=repo/"app"/"data"/"projects-live-control-plane-cutover-r42.json"
cut_state=None
if cut.exists():
    try: cut_state=json.loads(cut.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    except Exception as e: cut_state={"parseError":str(e)}
api_ok=False
server_started=None
api_error=None
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/status",timeout=3) as resp:
        body=json.load(resp)
    api_ok=True
    server_started=body.get("serverStartedAt")
except Exception as e:
    api_error=str(e)
print(json.dumps({
    "head":head,
    "gitStatus":status,
    "cutoverExists":cut.exists(),
    "cutoverStatus":None if cut_state is None else cut_state.get("status"),
    "holdActive":None if cut_state is None else cut_state.get("holdActive"),
    "apiOk":api_ok,
    "serverStartedAt":server_started,
    "apiError":api_error
},ensure_ascii=True))
